# `react/TimeframeChips`

A radio group over the intervals a build serves, with the accessible name coming from the
label channel. `describe` is what turns `1h` into whatever the reader should hear.

## Example

```ts
import type { ChartWorkspaceProps } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

export const served: NonNullable<ChartWorkspaceProps['catalogue']>['servedTimeframes'] = ['1h', '4h'];
```

## `TimeframeChipsProps`

Derived from the interface and from the destructuring in the component, so a default that
changes in the code changes here.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `options` | `readonly string[]` | yes | — |
| `active` | `string` | yes | — |
| `onChange` | `(timeframe: string) => void` | yes | — |
| `describe` | `((timeframe: string) => string) \| undefined` | no | — |
| `label` | `string \| undefined` | no | `'Timeframe'` |
| `theme` | `WorkspaceTheme \| undefined` | no | `DEFAULT_WORKSPACE_THEME` |
